instruction: A brass deep-sea diving helmet bristling with riveted seams, porthole glass faceplates ringed in copper, and clustered pressure gauges and valve wheels. Verdigris patina streaks the aged metal, and coiled brass tubes and a small pilot lamp jut from its bolted crown.
